aircraft._commentFlaps: No aircraft-specific flap detents are configured; use physical flap angle or raw handle percent pending in-sim handle-index verification.

aircraftCfg._comment: Use aircraft.cfg only when B38M is paired with an exact canonical or Microsoft/Asobo-qualified MAX 8 title and an exact first-party creator. B38M alone is intentionally insufficient. Optional traffic/selectability fields are not required because Microsoft permits them to be omitted.

lvars._comment: Four documented A-var reads supply wing, nose taxi and left/right runway-turnoff outputs. Two aircraft-scoped L:1 variables confirm fixed landing selectors independently of TAXI AUTO lamp behavior. The adapter separately subscribes to altitude slot 3 in feet.

controls._comment: 46 guarded actions, 25 confirmation fields and 46 logical fields. Thirty standard events and four native Input Events. Altitude writes slot 3 and confirms its actual MCP display source. Native taxi targets only the nose selector; landing confirms both scoped fixed selectors. Individual NAV/strobe requests preserve the other output; phase presets set and confirm POSITION outputs together. Writes remain bounded, identity-bound, fresh-readback confirmed and never retried. Flight modes remain unvalidated.

meta.notes: Experimental exact passenger-preset integration: 46 fields, 46 guarded actions, seven bounded gauge subscriptions. Parked follow-up on 2026-10-02 corrected altitude slot, landing selector confirmation, taxi collateral switching and combined POSITION presets. MCP heading, IAS and corrected altitude changes/restoration were visually observed; three phase presets passed the production command service. Action labels remain untested pending broader acceptance. No flight or variant parity is asserted. See docs/MICROSOFT-737-MAX-PROFILE-VALIDATION.md.

sources.name: MAX passenger installed Behavior debugger ValueCode
sources.notes: MSFS 2024 1.8.16.0: exact passenger interior.xml. FCC_ALTITUDE_SEL ValueCode reads A:AUTOPILOT ALTITUDE LOCK VAR:3 in feet; standard AP_ALT_VAR_SET_ENGLISH index 3 visually changes/restores the MCP. LIGHTING_LANDING_LIGHT_FIXED_L and LIGHTING_LANDING_LIGHT_FIXED_R ValueCode independently reads L:1:XMLVAR_LIGHT_LANDING_FIXED_L and L:1:XMLVAR_LIGHT_LANDING_FIXED_R. Isolated off/on and opposite-side probes confirmed both with taxi OFF/AUTO. Installed behavior is version-specific evidence.

sources.name: Microsoft / Asobo MAX 8 runtime Input Event interface
sources.notes: Runtime enumeration plus isolated parked probes establish LIGHTING_POSITION_LIGHT 1/OFF, 0/STEADY, 2/STROBE & STEADY; LIGHTING_LANDING_LIGHT_FIXED_L and LIGHTING_LANDING_LIGHT_FIXED_R 0/ON, 1/OFF; LIGHTING_TAXI_LIGHT_GEAR 0/AUTO, 1/OFF. LIGHT TAXI ON:3 follows nose taxi, :1/:2 follow turnoff and :4 wheel-well. Behavior debugger separately exposes L:1:XMLVAR_LIGHT_LANDING_FIXED_L and L:1:XMLVAR_LIGHT_LANDING_FIXED_R true/ON; these confirm fixed selectors when TAXI AUTO lights both landing outputs. See the dated validation record for exact observations and limitations.

sources.name: MSFS 2024 SDK - Aircraft Autopilot and Flight Assist Events
sources.notes: Source for every active flight-guidance event: AUTOPILOT_OFF, AUTOPILOT_ON, TOGGLE_FLIGHT_DIRECTOR, AUTO_THROTTLE_ARM, AP_AIRSPEED_OFF, AP_AIRSPEED_ON, AP_HDG_HOLD_OFF, AP_HDG_HOLD_ON, AP_ALT_HOLD_OFF, AP_ALT_HOLD_ON, AP_VS_OFF, AP_VS_ON, AP_NAV1_HOLD_OFF, AP_NAV1_HOLD_ON, AP_APR_HOLD_OFF, AP_APR_HOLD_ON, FLIGHT_LEVEL_CHANGE_OFF, FLIGHT_LEVEL_CHANGE_ON, AP_SPD_VAR_SET, HEADING_BUG_SET, AP_ALT_VAR_SET_ENGLISH, and AP_VS_VAR_SET_ENGLISH. Toggle events serve guarded OFF/ON logical intents only after fresh readback. These are generic simulator semantics, not independent Boeing CMD A/B, MCP selector, LNAV/VNAV, or proprietary autothrottle behavior.

These routes were replaced with separately evidenced native fixed selectors. See the session record.

sources.name: MSFS 2024 SDK - Aircraft System Variables (individual wing and landing lights)
sources.notes: Documents individual LIGHT WING and indexed LIGHT TAXI ON lamp outputs. Native/gauge masks omit wing on this preset. Landing lamp outputs are not fixed switch confirmation because TAXI AUTO illuminates them too. Scoped landing selector mirrors come from the separately inspected installed Behavior ValueCode.

knownIssues: The MSFS 2024 title 737 Max 8 Passengers and exact asobo_b737max/presets/asobo/b737max8_passengers/config/aircraft.CFG path were captured live on 2026-10-02. The corrected matcher accepts that vendor-qualified path; the unqualified passenger title alone remains insufficient. Older path hints remain provisional. See docs/MICROSOFT-737-MAX-PROFILE-VALIDATION.md.
The Microsoft Flight Simulator aircraft manuals page does not list a 737 MAX 8 manual.
AUTOPILOT_ON and AUTOPILOT_OFF expose only generic simulator master behavior. They cannot select or independently confirm Boeing CMD A versus CMD B.
Flight-director and autothrottle-arm OFF/ON intents share documented toggle events behind fresh readback. Standard state may still differ from the aircraft's internal annunciation or switch state.

Standard mode and target events do not reproduce proprietary Boeing MCP or autothrottle semantics. NAV hold is only a generic standard-state contract, and VNAV remains excluded; generic flight-level change is not asserted to reproduce every Boeing LVL CHG transition.

NAV OFF/STEADY and strobe STEADY/STROBE & STEADY use the shared POSITION selector. NAV requires fresh strobes OFF; strobe requires fresh NAV ON. These guards preserve the other lamp output. Paired landing uses two independently confirmed native selectors, 0/ON and 1/OFF. Other native light detents and runway-turnoff writes remain unverified. Standard lamp outputs cannot establish all cockpit switch positions.
Spoiler state remains read-only; no spoiler, raw-axis, vendor-private, macro, engine, or deep-system writes are enabled.
Flap handle indexes are not confirmed, so this profile intentionally defines no local flap notch table.
All active write routes retain untested verification labels pending broader cockpit, UI/voice and flight acceptance; scoped live evidence is recorded separately.

Earlier slot-0 altitude and generic indexed landing confirmation were superseded by independent visual/interaction checks. Native altitude GetInputEvent remained cached during a slot-3 change. Current altitude confirms slot 3; fixed landing confirms scoped selectors. Aircraft-specific target readback is corrected; generic simulator slot-0 telemetry may still differ. Three production light phase presets passed with restoration; no airborne or full UI/voice acceptance is claimed.
